caption: Goldfish swim in an aquarium and are clearly visible through the glass.

sa.check: An aquarium filled with water is present.
The fish are visible through the glass.
The fish swim: they move through the water.

pc.expect: The fish stay inside the water; the glass is a barrier they never cross, and tank decorations are solid to them.
pc.fail: A fish passes through the glass or swims out into the room; or a fish appears outside the tank; or fish swim through decorations as if they were not there.

pc.expect: The glass and water are transparent: fish are seen through them wherever the tank is in view.
pc.fail: The glass turns opaque and hides the fish; or the water blocks the view of fish at the back while the front is clear.

pc.expect: The fish stay submerged; the water surface stays level at the top of the tank.
pc.fail: A fish hovers above the water surface; or the water surface tilts and holds; or the water level changes with no cause.

pc.expect: The fish move as fish: smooth swimming with tail motion and turning without jumps in position.
pc.fail: A fish slides with a rigid body and no tail motion; or moves backwards at speed tail-first; or spins in place like a propeller.

pc.expect: The number of fish is constant; each keeps its shape and identity with no merging or splitting.
pc.fail: Fish appear or vanish; or two fish merge; or a fish splits; or a fish changes into something else; or a fish jumps from one place to another between frames.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Fish colours, decorations and the tank frame stay the same; refraction may shift things slightly but the layout is constant.
pc.fail: A fish changes colour; or decorations move on their own; or the tank frame changes shape.

note: Fish are self-driven: where they go, when they start and stop is not judged. This caption has no triggered event; the physics is transparency and containment.
